entities.summary: Georgios Papagiannis, is a Greek professional basketball player for Anadolu Efes of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroLeague. Born in Marousi, Attica, Greece, he is a 7 ft 2 3⁄4 in tall center, with a 7 ft 6 in wingspan. An All-EuroLeague Second Team selection in 2022, Papagiannis is a member of the senior National Team of Greece.
